places.name: Queens Park
places.ai_summary: A sprawling park in the heart of Invercargill, featuring gardens, walking trails, and a golf course.

opening_hours.notes: Accessible year-round.

places.place_tip: Visit the aviary and rose garden for a relaxing experience.

places.ai_summary: A pristine island known for its wildlife, hiking trails, and the Rakiura National Park.
